next_step: POC: 2-week local-index + streaming latency test; set up private eval cluster
overview: SherpaIDE builds a JetBrains plugin that provides low-latency, private code completions and a lightweight IDE copilot using on-device local indexes and optional cloud fallback. Targeting IntelliJ/PyCharm initially, roadmap includes WebStorm and GoLand. Looking for inference partner to power streaming completions, workspace-level model pinning, and enterprise deployment options.
crm_notes:
- Product: JetBrains plugin (IntelliJ/PyCharm) + local index sync agent.
- Key asks: sub-50ms first-token streaming on local network, ability to pin model version per workspace, quantized model support for on-device inference, and audit logging for code lookup queries.
- Customer quote: "We need offline suggestions when engineers are on planes — but also fall back to cloud for large contexts."
- Concern: licensing for shipping quantized weights inside plugin (legal + distro).
- Interest in Redwood Optimize for batching suggestions and model/quantization recommendations.
- Prefer Private deployment (VPC) for enterprise customers, but also want a hosted option for freemium users.
- Pricing sensitivity: small per-developer seat price for SMBs; enterprise license for internal teams.
- Marketplace: want to list on JetBrains Marketplace; need privacy guarantees for telemetry and prompt content.

use_case_summary: Primary: low-latency code completion with on-device/local-index fallback and cloud-augmented completions for large context. Secondary: semantic search over code, context-aware refactor suggestions, and per-project model pinning to avoid regressions.
technical_requirements:
- Local index updated via background sync (encrypted).
- Lightweight on-device quantized model support (4-bit or 8-bit).
- Streaming token-by-token completions exposed to JetBrains UI; cancelable suggestions.
- Model pinning per repo/workspace and rollout controls (canary).
- Telemetry must be opt-in; all code snippets in queries must be redacted/hashed for telemetry.
